purpose: Run one approximately three-second local streaming smoke per candidate and record diagnostic RTF and peak process-tree RSS without publishing a score, ranking, or qualification decision.
memory_policy: Fail closed and terminate the candidate if sampled process-tree RSS exceeds the budget. Report the observed peak; absence of an overshoot sample does not prove a hard kernel-enforced bound.
execution_environment: workstation CPU only; models, runtimes, audio, transcripts, and raw output remain outside Git
offline_policy: Use only pre-acquired checksum-verified local artifacts. The execution command receives external artifact paths explicitly and must not auto-download.

fixture.schedule: deterministic ordered PCM chunks without wall-clock sleeping for decode-cost RTF

metrics.model_load_seconds: resident runtime load time when exposed by the native API
metrics.decode_wall_seconds: warm-model elapsed time for one complete streaming utterance
metrics.cold_total_seconds: load plus warmup plus decode when the native executable cannot expose a resident API boundary
metrics.peak_process_tree_rss_bytes: maximum sampled sum of VmRSS for the command process tree

candidate_commands.native_rtfx_conversion: RTF equals 1 divided by the reported rtfx

smoke_completion_definition: The exact artifact loads, accepts the complete frozen PCM stream, returns a non-empty final, stays within the sampled RSS budget, exits cleanly, and emits complete diagnostic metrics.
interpretation_limit: A workstation pass is development evidence only. It is not a formal score, comparative ranking, Pi hardware disposition, zh-TW quality conclusion, or qualification decision.
current_blocker: The checksum-bound controlled WAV is not present in known local controlled storage. No artifact acquisition or real model load may start until it is restored and passes preflight.
